name: Garryhundon
questions: The fourth bedroom on the floor plan is 3.43 × 1.63 m. Is there any scope (planning or space on the 2,700 m² site) to extend for a proper fourth double bedroom or a second living room?
Is the house on mains water or a group scheme, or a private well? Is drainage a septic tank or treatment system, and when was it last desludged or inspected?
BuyerIQ puts a mapped river flood zone about 0.5 km away. Has the house, garden or access road ever flooded, and is flood cover available on the buildings insurance?
How close is the M9, and can traffic be heard from the garden? What is the planning application lodged within 1 km of the house for?
Are the 10 solar panels PV (electricity) or thermal (hot water), and how old are the oil boiler and the panels? Are the boundaries stock-proof all round (we have two dogs)?

ai.why: A tidy B3 bungalow, all on one level with two en-suite bedrooms, 10 minutes from Carlow town and its station, at €450k. Held back by 154 m² with only three real bedrooms (the fourth is 3.43 × 1.63 m), plain looks, a 0.67 ac site and about 30 minutes to a children's ED.

electricity.detail: Connected; lived-in house with 10 solar panels on the roof (type not stated).

water.detail: Not stated in the listing. A rural one-off house, so it could be mains, a group scheme or a private well; ask.

sewer.detail: Not stated in the listing. Probably a septic tank or treatment unit for a rural site; ask its age and certification.

internet.detail: Full fibre at the address per BuyerIQ ('Fast broadband — 387 Mb full fibre'); the listing doesn't mention broadband and the provider isn't confirmed.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Single storey: every bedroom is on the ground floor, including two doubles with en-suites (3.73 × 4.47 m and 4.87 × 4.44 m) per the floor plan.

heating: Oil-fired central heating, solid-fuel stove insert, 10 solar panels
tagline: A tidy single-storey bungalow on about two-thirds of an acre between Leighlinbridge and Carlow, a few minutes off the M9.

pros.detail: About €2,920/m² on the 154 m² floor plan. Stamp duty about €4,500.

pros.text: All on one level, two en-suites
pros.detail: Single storey: the parents could take the 4.87 × 4.44 m double with its own shower room; three bathrooms in all.

pros.text: Close to Carlow and its station
pros.detail: Under 10 minutes to Carlow town (per the listing); Carlow station has about 10 direct weekday trains to Heuston, roughly 1h to 1h20.

pros.text: B3 and ready to move into
pros.detail: 145.5 kWh/m²/yr with 10 solar panels; the listing says it is in excellent condition throughout.
Tyndall College (mixed) is on Carlow's Kilkenny Road; Knockbeg College (boys) and Presentation Askea (mixed) are also in reach.
BuyerIQ shows 387 Mb full fibre at the address.
A Barrow-side village with the Lord Bagenal Inn and the Barrow Way, per the listing's 5-minute drive.

cons.text: Tight for six: three real bedrooms
cons.detail: 154 m², and the fourth bedroom is 3.43 × 1.63 m, a box room or study. Living space is one 10.3 × 3.8 m kitchen/living area plus a 3.6 × 5.5 m living room.
Carlow has no ED; St Luke's Kilkenny is about 35 km, Portlaoise about 45 km.
c. 2,700 m² (0.67 ac), mostly lawn; fine for dogs, but not the acre of the brief, and the photos show a house across the road.
Standard dashed bungalow with uPVC windows; tidy, but little character.
BuyerIQ flags moderate river flood risk with a mapped flood zone ~0.5 km off (the Barrow valley); check insurance and the access road.
Rural site; likely a septic tank and possibly a well or group scheme. Ask.
A wire runs to the house in the facade photo, and the M9 junction is about 4 minutes away; check for road noise and poles on the site.
